call_points.versus_prior: reiterated double-digit revenue growth; margin band newly quantified

call_points.text: GCM division EBITDA margin seen at 10-12% in FY27, up from 6% in FY26 including SCS.
SAL Chennai Plant-2 is purely capacity building as SAL is running out of physical infrastructure.
SCS turned EBITDA positive in Q4FY26 at about 2%, after negative margins through Q1-Q3.
GCM margin gain is driven by restructuring, not tariff recovery; tariff recovery would be an additional bonus.
PLD margin fell about 200 bps in FY26 on inability to pass on molybdenum and tungsten costs and weak TRIFA sales.
Electronics division won business for digital clusters and electronic throttle controls, expected to carry into FY27.
Total debt was ₹785 Cr at March 2026; surplus cash in mutual funds was ₹235 Cr.
About $1-2 million of unrecoverable tariff was absorbed in FY26 P&L and will recur in FY27; guidance includes it.
Divisions renamed: DCD to ICM, SCD to GCM, SED to Sensors Electronics and Displays, PLD to PLE; financial groupings unchanged.

operating_notes.text: SCS entities turned EBITDA positive in Q4FY26 at ₹27 million (2.1% margin), after a full-year EBITDA loss of ₹237 million.
Group debt rose to ₹785.0 Cr at Mar-26 from ₹657.1 Cr at Mar-25; mutual fund and bond investments were ₹235.4 Cr.
No customer accounts for more than 10% of Suprajit revenue, per the investor FAQ.
GCM division secured USD 12 million/year in new contracts in May 2026 with a lifetime value of USD 75 million.
FY26 consolidated revenue excluding SCS was ₹3,377 Cr, up 8.7% YoY; operational EBITDA was ₹443 Cr, up 10.5%.
FY26 standalone revenue was ₹1,840 Cr, up 7.1% YoY; standalone operational EBITDA was ₹305 Cr, up 2.4%.
SCS quarterly EBITDA margin trajectory in FY26: about -20% in Q1, -6% in Q2, -2% in Q3 and +2% in Q4.

timeline.summary: FY26 results and investor presentation (25 May 2026): Q4FY26 revenue ₹1,042 Cr (+18.8% YoY), PBT ₹97.2 Cr (+93.7% YoY); SCS turned EBITDA positive in Q4; FY27 capex guided at ₹200 Cr.
On June 1, 2026, Suprajit Engineering announced business updates including new GCM division contract wins worth USD 12 million annually.
On 1 June 2026, Suprajit filed the transcript of its 26 May 2026 Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin at 12-13.5% and GCM division margin at 10-12% from 6%.
